latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of jianglong-18palms skill.
- Triggers when user mentions the name or number of a "降龙十八掌" move.
- Automatically generates an ancient-style SVG illustration of the specified move, including classic elements like a martial artist silhouette, dragon motifs, and calligraphic text.
- Provides a classical Chinese (文言文) style introduction of the move, detailing its name, origin, key principles, usage scenarios, and a poetic training mnemonic.
- Includes a full table of all eighteen moves with origins and core meanings.
- Prompts the user to specify a move if none is mentioned, or selects one at random.
